preamble: No direct change of plain /r/ to the postalveolar fricative [ʃ] has been found. The case previously filed here, Central Swedish and Eastern Norwegian /rs/ > [ʂ], is coalescence of r with a following s and yields the retroflex [ʂ], already recorded under r_to_sh_retroflex. The closest genuine [ʃ] outcome, Upper Sorbian ř [ʃ] after p, t, k (tři /ˈtʃi/ 'three', přez /ˈpʃɛs/ 'through'), comes from palatalized *rʲ through a fricative-trill stage and so belongs to a palatalized-r chain rather than to this cell.

examples.note: r + s fuse into a single retroflex [ʂ], not [ʃ]; see r_to_sh_retroflex.
